<function name="ComputePixelDiameterOfSphere" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Calculates diameter of a 3D sphere on a 2D screen.

<rendercontext hook="false" type="3D"></rendercontext>
</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<added>2023.09.06</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="point" type="Vector">The position of the sphere in 3D space.</arg>
		<arg name="radius" type="number">The radius of the sphere in 3D space.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret type="number">The diameter of the sphere in 2D screen space.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
<code>
hook.Add( "HUDPaint", "HUDPaint_PixelDiameterOfSphereExample", function()

	local point = Vector( 0, 0, 0 )
	
	cam.Start3D()
	local diameter = render.ComputePixelDiameterOfSphere( point, 10 ) 
	cam.End3D()

	local pos2D = point:ToScreen()	
	surface.DrawCircle( pos2D.x, pos2D.y, diameter / 2, Color( 255, 120, 0 ) )

end )
</code>

</example>
